title: Stock Contract — Payload Schema
description: Draft. Delta update pushed by erp.inventory under inventory.stock.v1. Consumers must process messages in sequence order and discard any message with a sequence number <= the last processed sequence for that product.

updates.description: One or more stock changes in this push. Each item is a delta for a single product.

product_id.description: References the id field in catalog.product-knowledge.v1

quantity_available.description: Current available quantity after this update. Not a delta — always an absolute value.

sequence.description: Monotonically increasing per product_id. Consumers must discard any message where sequence <= last seen sequence for this product_id.

warehouse_id.description: Null until ADR-004 is resolved. Multi-warehouse support pending.

batch_sequence.description: Monotonically increasing batch identifier. Consumers can use this to detect dropped batches.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when erp.inventory generated this push
